name: WxArticleSaver
scope: WeChat article pages opened by the user; export occurs only after manual trigger
certificate: generated locally; trusted in CurrentUser Root only while running; trust removed on normal exit
certificate_files: kept locally under .wxas_ca for reuse; ignored by git
routing: PAC: selected WeChat article/media hosts -> local proxy; all other hosts DIRECT
cached_page_fallback: best-effort one-shot Ctrl+R only when foreground process is WeChat/Weixin
